name: B10-0141/2024 (PPE) – Situation in Azerbaijan, violation of human rights and international law and relations with Armenia
title: Situation in Azerbaijan, violation of human rights and international law and relations with Armenia
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on the European Union to impose sanctions on Azerbaijani officials accused of serious human rights abuses, to stop buying oil and gas from Azerbaijan, and to freeze military exports to it. It also asks Azerbaijan to release people held on politically motivated charges and to withdraw its troops from Armenia's territory. It supports closer ties between the EU and Armenia, including visa-free travel and defence cooperation. The text is a statement of the Parliament's position and does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; the Parliament is asking the EU and member states to act.
- **Who it affects:** Azerbaijan's government and economy, Armenia, and EU countries that trade with Azerbaijan.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to EU institutions and to Azerbaijan; decisions on sanctions and energy imports rest with EU governments.
